items.body:
Parse each styled item with `Text.from_markup(item_text)` and search its `.plain` value, which contains the rendered text without style tags. The [markup docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/markup.rst) describe `Text.from_markup`. For usage questions, please ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
